title: Proposal to Regulate Petrol and Diesel Pump Prices Given Recent Increases
what_it_is: Proposal to Regulate Petrol and Diesel Pump Prices Given Recent Increases

sections.label: Global and Singapore fuel prices
sections.summary: Global crude oil prices rose due to higher demand and constrained supplies, and Singapore fuel prices rose in tandem.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Global crude oil prices have risen significantly, driven by higher demand as economies reopen following the pandemic as well as constrained supplies due to sanctions against Russia and under-investment in fossil fuel production over the years.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Fuel prices in Singapore have also risen in tandem.

sections.label: Fuel price regulation and market competition
sections.summary: Regulating pump prices would distort the market and benefit car owners, so the Government ensures a competitive fuel retail market monitored by CCCS.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: In response to Mr Don Wee's question, regulating or capping petrol or diesel pump prices will distort the market and serve to benefit car owners, especially those who consume more, who may include more well-to-do users.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: It will also reduce the incentive for Singaporeans to switch to more energy-efficient modes of transport.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Instead, the Government's approach is to ensure that we have a competitive fuel retail market.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: I want to assure all Members and the House that the Competition and Consumer Commission of Singapore (CCCS) monitors the fuel market closely and will not hesitate to investigate the practices of the retail operators.

sections.label: One-off relief for drivers
sections.summary: Eligible taxi hirers and private hire drivers get a one-off $150 relief, and some other drivers can apply for up to $300.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Eligible taxi main hirers and private hire car drivers will receive a one-off relief of $150 next month.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Drivers of combi buses and limousines who are members of the National Private Hire Vehicle Association, as well as delivery drivers and delivery motorcycle riders who are members of the National Delivery Champions Association can apply for a one-off cash relief of up to $300 next month under the NTUC U FSE Relief Scheme 2022.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: The Government will review the fuel retail market to determine if there are other ways to alleviate the pressure on fuel prices.
